data.narrative:
Figure AI, a Series C artificial intelligence and software company founded by Brett Adcock, has raised over $1 billion and carries a current post-money valuation of $39.0 billion. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of nine private and one public peer in the AI & Software sector, including same-stage and adjacent-stage companies such as Skild AI ($14.0B Series C), Wayve ($8.6B Series D), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B).

Two methods were applied to triangulate fair value. The stage-progression method applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implying a forward valuation of $66.3 billion from the current $39.0B post-money baseline. The peer-median method examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, yielding a median valuation of $7.1 billion with a range of $3.2 billion to $14.0 billion. These two approaches produce a wide divergence, reflecting material tension between Figure AI's last-round valuation and observable peer valuations.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $6.0 billion to $76.2 billion, with a median implication of $36.7 billion. The wide spread and two-order magnitude delta between peer-median and stage-progression methods underscore key valuation uncertainties: whether Figure AI's current $39.0B valuation reflects a genuine premium justified by differentiated technology and commercial execution, or represents elevated pricing relative to recent peer financing activity and stage-appropriate comparables.
